whatIs: Httpster is a gallery of hand-picked websites, with more than 3,000 entries and a marked taste for the typographic, minimalist, and brutalist. Each entry shows a thumbnail, has its own page within Httpster, and a link to visit the original site.
You browse it by 19 styles (Minimal, Photographic, Typographic…) and 29 site types (Ecommerce, Showcase, Design & Illustration…), with the number of entries next to each name.
uses: Seeing examples of type-driven design by entering through the Typographic style.
Looking for online store references by filtering by the Ecommerce type.
Gathering minimalist examples to define the visual direction of a portfolio.
caveats: There's no search: you can only reach sites by style, type, or by paging.
Promoted entries appear among the listings, such as one from Mobbin.
It shows how a site looks, not how it's built: there's no technical detail for each design.
idealFor: Designers and developers looking for typographic and minimalist references.
